label: Framework Laptop 13
description: 13.5-inch 3:2 modular laptop, AMD Ryzen AI 300, four user-selectable Expansion Cards and Wi-Fi 7.
notes: Ethernet exists only as an Expansion Card: the 2.5GbE RJ45 card occupies one of the four slots, so the port is present only if the card is fitted. Wi-Fi 7 (RZ717) is always onboard - perfect for modelling a host whose wired port is optional hardware.
